rows.requirement: Home/Concept should lead with whole-preserving knowledge exploration, not 3D graphics/language as the product itself.
rows.current_main_evidence: Home and Concept still define 3DSL primarily as a three-dimensional structural language / framework for concepts and relations in 3D.
rows.candidate_branch_asset: None of #52/#53/#54 materially resolves product copy.
rows.architecture_note: Rewrite product-facing copy; no runtime rewrite required.

rows.requirement: 3D must be presented as conditional structural value, not universal necessity or a cognitive superiority claim.
rows.current_main_evidence: Home says thought/understanding moves across multiple axes/viewpoints/grains 'simultaneously' and 3D preserves that simultaneity; Top copy claims a stronger public good than language.
rows.candidate_branch_asset: Approved Product v1 provides the corrected claim discipline.

rows.requirement: Reader/Explorer must be primary; Author/Mapper secondary.
rows.current_main_evidence: Home targets a broad mixed audience and Concept centers people who view/create 3DSS; reader-first role priority is not explicit.

rows.requirement: First-time user should understand What / Why / How before controls and implementation vocabulary.
rows.current_main_evidence: Hero is poetic and lower-page explanation is implementation/3D-centric; direct core v1 sentence is not the dominant first message.

rows.requirement: One canonical reader-facing Viewer entry should preserve Library return/context.
rows.current_main_evidence: Main uses both `/app/viewer` and `/viewer`; nav and Library use `/app/viewer`, while Home/Concept also link `/viewer`.
rows.candidate_branch_asset: No branch has established a product-level canonical route decision.
rows.architecture_note: Step 9 must choose one public entry and classify the other as internal/compat.

rows.requirement: Content SSOT/build/index/detail pipeline should be stable.
rows.current_main_evidence: `packages/3dss-content` -> generated index/data -> Astro Library is implemented with checks and documented SSOT.

rows.requirement: Library should be a primary public entry demonstrating 3DSL value.
rows.current_main_evidence: Library is first in main nav after Home, featured on Home, and has an index/detail flow.

rows.requirement: Diagram detail should provide context then direct Viewer entry.
rows.current_main_evidence: Detail page provides title/summary, preview, authors, optional text/references/rights, and a full-screen `/app/viewer` entry with return context.

rows.requirement: Public items should provide an authored entry/explanation route when the model is dense.
rows.current_main_evidence: `entry_points` is reserved in metadata/build types, but published items inspected have empty/no entry points and no site/viewer execution path uses it.
rows.architecture_note: Architecture pressure for an explanation-route contract outside/alongside core 3DSS.

rows.requirement: Public Library should contain deliberate product examples rather than tests/drafts/sample plumbing.
rows.current_main_evidence: Published main items include a stress/load-test item, an empty item titled `26012801` tagged draft, and a folder-structure sample.

rows.requirement: Public conceptual examples must not contradict Product v1 / validated QQT boundaries.
rows.current_main_evidence: Published item `3DSL三軸座標系` describes a 3DSL three-axis definition and contains Quantity/Quality/Time axis labels; Product v1 says axes are model-specific and 3D is conditional.
rows.architecture_note: Revise/reclassify public content before release; do not encode QQT as universal axes.

rows.requirement: Featured/recommended status should have one SSOT.
rows.current_main_evidence: `_meta.json` defines `recommended`, while Home selects featured items using `m:top` / `m:default` tags and ignores `recommended`.
rows.architecture_note: Choose one curation signal in Step 9.

rows.requirement: Infrastructure should support sources/rights/provenance.
rows.current_main_evidence: `_meta.json` has authors, references, rights, provenance, links; detail page renders meaningful references/rights.

rows.requirement: Published content should actually fill provenance/rights/source fields to a useful level.
rows.current_main_evidence: Several published items have no references/rights; one inspected item contains placeholder/empty fields despite meta policy preferring explicit UNKNOWN.

rows.requirement: Users should be able to continue to related/comparison examples.
rows.current_main_evidence: `related` and `pairs` are reserved but inspected published metadata is empty; no reader-facing related/pair flow was found.
rows.architecture_note: Use existing reserved fields or replace with one coherent navigation contract.

rows.requirement: The free Library as a set should demonstrate whole↔internal, placement/comparison, heterogeneous connection, and explanation routes.
rows.current_main_evidence: Current publishing metadata does not declare or verify capability coverage; explanation-route coverage is absent.
rows.architecture_note: Curate a small representative release set against Product v1 capabilities.

rows.requirement: Basic rendering and navigation should work.
rows.current_main_evidence: Viewer has load/render, orbit/pan/zoom, pick, selection, visibility, frames, axis controls, snapshot/embed infrastructure.
rows.candidate_branch_asset: Existing CI/regression assets support this foundation.

rows.requirement: Viewer should permit whole↔local movement and return.
rows.current_main_evidence: Viewer has macro/micro modes; picking focuses into micro and exiting restores the saved macro camera state.
rows.candidate_branch_asset: None needed for the basic mechanism.

rows.requirement: Local view should represent meaningful local structure, not only camera proximity/neighborhood.
rows.current_main_evidence: Micro state is mainly focus item + 1-hop related UUIDs + local bounds. Explicit composite/internal structure semantics are not a general contract.
rows.architecture_note: Step 9 should decide whether model conventions/metadata/runtime derivation are enough before any schema change.

rows.requirement: Reader should know where they are in the whole, what is focused, and how to return.
rows.current_main_evidence: Viewer host carries title/back-to-Library and runtime has macro/micro labels; no reader-facing breadcrumb/whole-position/explanation context was found.
rows.architecture_note: Add reader orientation layer without exposing runtime internals.

rows.requirement: Reader should know what changed when scale/scope/viewpoint changes.
rows.current_main_evidence: Camera, frame and mode exist, but product-level semantic labels for scope/grain/viewpoint are not a stable reader contract.
rows.architecture_note: Define product semantics separately from camera/frame implementation.

rows.requirement: Meaningful axes/position/direction need model-specific interpretation.
rows.current_main_evidence: World axes and geometric coordinate system exist; no general reader-facing contract communicates model-specific semantic axis/placement meaning.
rows.architecture_note: Likely content/context metadata + UI; schema change not yet justified.

rows.requirement: Viewer should execute an authored explanation route through the same model.
rows.current_main_evidence: No route/tour/story/breadcrumb implementation was found in Viewer SSOT; Library `entry_points` is not consumed.
rows.architecture_note: Core reader-facing feature pressure for Step 9.

rows.requirement: Reader should be able to compare regions/models where useful.
rows.current_main_evidence: `/app/compare` exists but is a Viewer-vs-Modeler debug parity tool, not a reader comparison experience.
rows.architecture_note: Later reader comparison can use Library pairs/related; not first blocker if core routes work.

rows.requirement: Schema/spec/viewer documentation routes should exist.
rows.current_main_evidence: Main has `/docs`, schema/spec routes, viewer docs, FAQ route, Concept route.

rows.requirement: Concept copy must match approved Product v1 and claim boundaries.
rows.current_main_evidence: Concept defines 3DSL as a framework for placing concepts/relations in 3D and centers 3DSS samples/creation; it does not lead with whole-preserving exploration or conditional 3D.

rows.requirement: A clear 'How to read a 3DSL diagram' entry should exist.
rows.current_main_evidence: Docs tree has technical contracts/ops, but no dedicated reader-facing reading guide was found.
rows.architecture_note: Create product-level reading guide and link from Library/Viewer.

rows.requirement: Approved Product Definition v1 should become canonical repository docs.
rows.current_main_evidence: The approved `docs/product/*` bundle exists in project artifacts, but no corresponding canonical product directory was found on main.
rows.architecture_note: Repository integration required before architecture implementation.

rows.requirement: Core concept, Viewer, docs and representative Library experience should be usable without payment.
rows.current_main_evidence: Main Library/Viewer/docs are public and do not require Premium access.

rows.requirement: Canonical product docs/site should express Free core vs Premium content depth.
rows.current_main_evidence: Main does not contain the approved content-depth product boundary.
rows.candidate_branch_asset: #52/#53 contain Premium policy/implementation assets but predate Product v1 boundary.
rows.architecture_note: First encode product boundary, then assess mechanism.

rows.requirement: Premium delivery should exist only after the product boundary is clear.
rows.current_main_evidence: Canonical main lacks the Premium routes/auth assets described in the old roadmap.
rows.architecture_note: Recover only after Step 9 architecture decision.

rows.requirement: One branch/state must define Premium implementation truth.
rows.current_main_evidence: Main and #52/#53 materially differ: Premium is absent on main but substantial on the restructure stack.

rows.requirement: Willingness to pay should be empirically tested after core usability.
rows.current_main_evidence: No demand/willingness-to-pay evidence is established in current repository/product artifacts.
rows.candidate_branch_asset: Existing Premium mechanism is not demand evidence.

rows.requirement: Author tool should support place/connect/edit/validate/save/export.
rows.current_main_evidence: Modeler already has substantial editing, validation, history, preview and persistence functions.

rows.requirement: Modeler must not consume priority ahead of reader-facing Library/Viewer core.
rows.current_main_evidence: Modeler is comparatively mature while explanation routes, reader onboarding and Product v1 copy are missing.
rows.candidate_branch_asset: #54 is bounded maintenance, not feature expansion.

rows.requirement: Accepted preservation/semantic guards should not remain only on a draft branch indefinitely.
rows.current_main_evidence: Canonical main lacks the approved #54 import-loss, UUID/frame guards, conformance matrix and local-only sidecar contract.
rows.candidate_branch_asset: #54 is CI-passing and mergeable but draft.
rows.architecture_note: Integration decision belongs in Step 9 branch plan.

rows.requirement: Later author flow should connect Modeler output to an appropriate Library/content publication workflow.
rows.current_main_evidence: No integrated reader-safe Modeler→Library publish workflow is established.

rows.requirement: SSOT and layer boundaries should be explicit and machine-checkable.
rows.current_main_evidence: Viewer/Modeler manifests define layers, ports, forbidden dependencies and checks; AGENTS/docs identify SSOTs.

rows.requirement: Schema should not be expanded without concrete preservation loss.
rows.current_main_evidence: 3DSS v1.1.4 supports current product basics and no current P1 gap uniquely requires schema expansion.
rows.candidate_branch_asset: #54 also resolves preservation gaps without schema change.

rows.requirement: Build/dependency topology should not rely on unnecessary copies and duplicated generated trees.
rows.current_main_evidence: Main uses large vendor trees plus sync/mirror copies and generated-clean checks.
rows.candidate_branch_asset: #53 proposes workspaces; later restructure plan proposes vendor/sync removal.

rows.requirement: Main, restructure stack and QQT patch need one integration plan.
rows.current_main_evidence: Open #52/#53 stack and direct-main #54 represent divergent successor states.
rows.architecture_note: Step 9 must sequence/rebase/merge or retire branches.

rows.requirement: Repository should expose a coherent global verification contract.
rows.current_main_evidence: Main has extensive checks and `ci:build`, but no single canonical root `verify` command.

rows.requirement: Recovered baseline/audit should become repository-canonical evidence if used for architecture decisions.
rows.current_main_evidence: RMAP-REC-01 artifacts exist in project workspace, not canonical main.
rows.architecture_note: Integrate evidence docs without pretending UNKNOWNs are resolved.

rows.requirement: Automated CI/build/validation exists and recent candidate branches pass.
rows.current_main_evidence: GitHub Actions exists; #52, #53 and #54 each have successful CI runs.

rows.requirement: Release 1 should communicate Product v1 and demonstrate it through Library+Viewer.
rows.current_main_evidence: Technical Library/Viewer routes exist, but core copy, curation, explanation routes and reader orientation are not aligned with Product v1.
rows.candidate_branch_asset: #52/#53 mostly address repo/tooling, not these product gaps.
rows.architecture_note: Release should wait for product-alignment slice, not Modeler completion.

rows.requirement: Library should survive missing/bad index with a usable empty/error state.
rows.current_main_evidence: `readLibraryIndex()` throws on missing/invalid index and the `/library` page calls it directly.
rows.candidate_branch_asset: No branch evidence reviewed here closes this product behavior.

rows.requirement: Core reader path should be verified on mobile and for keyboard/ARIA.
rows.current_main_evidence: There is responsive UI, swipe navigation and multiple ARIA labels, but no consolidated acceptance evidence for the complete Product v1 reader flow.

rows.requirement: Condition/scenario trials can be added after core public product.
rows.current_main_evidence: Frames exist, but no product-level scenario comparison workflow is established.

rows.requirement: Collaborative atlas can be added after core public product.
rows.current_main_evidence: No collaborative atlas/multi-user product path is established.
